Regulation: B.C. Reg. 119/2026
Made under: Offence Act
Published in: No. 13 – B.C. Regs. 110 to 124, July 14, 2026
Deposit date: July 10, 2026

B.C. Reg. 119/2026, deposited July 10, 2026, under theOFFENCE ACT[section 132]. Order in Council 313/2026, approved and ordered July 10, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that, (a)	effective August 14, 2026, the Offence Act Forms Regulation, B.C. Reg. 422/90, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule 1, (b)	effective August 14, 2026, the Federal Contraventions Forms Regulation, B.C. Reg. 124/2005, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule 2, (c)	effective January 1, 2029, the Offence Act Forms Regulation is amended as set out in the attached Schedule 3, and (d)	effective January 1, 2029, the Federal Contraventions Forms Regulation is amended as set out in the attached Schedule 4. — N. SHARMA,Attorney General and Deputy Premier; A. DIX,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. 1	Section 2 of the Offence Act Forms Regulation, B.C. Reg. 422/90, is amended (a)	in subsection (1) by striking out "Form T or Form U" and substituting "Form T, Form U, Form V, Form W or Form Y", (b)	in subsection (1.1) by striking out "Form Q or Form R" and substituting "Form Q, Form R or Form X", (c)	in subsection (2) (h) by striking out "Form R" and substituting "Form R or Form X", (d)	in subsection (2) (i) by striking out "Form S" and substituting "Form S or Form Y", (e)	in subsection (2) (j) by striking out "Form T or Form U" and substituting "Form T, Form U, Form V or Form W", (f)	in subsection (3) (e) by striking out "Form S" and substituting "Form S or Form Y", and (g)	in subsection (3) (f) by striking out "Form T or Form U" and substituting "Form T, Form U, Form V or Form W". 2	The following forms are added: 1	Section 3 (1) of the Federal Contraventions Forms Regulation, B.C. Reg. 124/2005, is amended by striking out "Form A" and substituting "Form A or Form I". 1	Section 2 of the Offence Act Forms Regulation, B.C. Reg. 422/90, is amended (a)	in subsection (1) by striking out "Form H, Form K, Form L, Form O, Form S, Form T, Form U,", (b)	in subsection (1.1) by striking out "Form Q, Form R or",

minutes_briefs.title: New BC ticket forms for offences and federal contraventions take effect August 14, 2026
minutes_briefs.summary: British Columbia is updating the official forms used for tickets and violation notices under the Offence Act and the Federal Contraventions Act. New forms (V, W, X, Y, and I) are being added, and existing forms are being revised. These changes take effect in two stages: most updates start on August 14, 2026, and further changes follow on January 1, 2029. If your business deals with provincial or federal tickets—like parking, health, or safety violations—you'll need to use the new forms after these dates.
minutes_briefs.action_required: Update your ticket and violation notice templates to the new BC forms by August 14, 2026.

key_dates.label: New BC offence and contravention forms take effect
Further BC offence and contravention forms take effect
